name: Dub for Creators page launch
object: Dub's Creators solutions page: branded short links, QR codes, and real-time analytics built for content creators
audience: YouTube and content creators who need to prove to sponsoring brands exactly how their links and promo codes perform
message: This video tells creators that Dub gives them the same enterprise-grade link analytics brands use, so they can show sponsors exactly what their content delivers.

moments.what: a scrolling tour of the live page opens on a hero headline next to a real creator's branded short link and a strip of live stats
moments.copy: an essential pairing for your content creation — shown with a real branded link (go.hubermanlab.com) pulling 7.2K clicks, 165 leads, 12 sales

moments.what: copy explains the workflow benefit next to 'Start for free' and 'Get a demo' buttons and logos of creators already using it, then a customer quote appears
moments.copy: creators use Dub to streamline their workflow and gain deeper audience insights; one customer calls it hands-down better than Bitly

moments.what: the page scrolls into the real analytics dashboard, showing click/lead/sale totals and a chart broken down by country and device
moments.copy: gain deeper audience insights — 5,030 clicks, 2,215 leads, $6,589 in sales, broken down live

moments.what: the page closes on a row of named case-study cards, each linking out to a full success story
moments.copy: case studies from Fenitas, Efficient App, Craylor Media, and Code with Guillaume, each with a result to read

cta: The page offers 'Start for free' and 'Get a demo' buttons early on, then lets the named case studies (Fenitas, Efficient App, Craylor Media) carry the close instead of repeating the button.
why: It leads with a named real creator's branded link and live numbers instead of an abstract pitch, so a creator immediately pictures their own channel in the frame. Backing that with a specific outside quote and four named case studies, not just generic praise, gives a skeptical creator audience concrete proof before it asks them to start for free.
